# 🧠 Algorithm Specification

## Algorithm and reference
Name the formal algorithm and cite a primary textbook/paper or authoritative educational reference.

## Objective
What problem does the algorithm solve?

## Inputs and domain
Types, shape, valid ranges, categorical domains and missing-value policy.

## Outputs
Exact return type and meaning. Define tie-breaking and invalid states.

## Mathematical definition
State equations and assumptions.

## Invariants
List properties that must remain true after every update.

## Complexity
Time and space complexity, including relevant assumptions.

## Worked examples
Include a small hand-computed positive, negative and edge case.

## Tests
Map each invariant to deterministic unit tests.

## Known limitations
State what is not implemented.
